seo.title: Dental Implants Cost in Dubai: What Affects the Price | Bright Way
seo.description: What decides the price of a dental implant in Dubai: the number of implants, bone grafting, the crown and the planning. Book a consultation at Bright Way Dental Clinic, Al Garhoud.

html:
If you are missing a tooth, the first question is usually "how much will an implant cost in Dubai?" The honest answer is that it depends on your mouth, and a good clinic will only give you a firm figure after an examination and a scan. What we can do here is explain what goes into the price, so you know what you are paying for and can compare clinics fairly.

What you are paying for

A dental implant is not one item. It is three parts and a plan:

  • The implant itself: a small titanium post placed in the jawbone, where the root used to be.
  • The abutment: the connector that joins the implant to the visible tooth.
  • The crown: the tooth you see and chew with, usually ceramic or zirconia, matched to the colour of your other teeth.
  • The planning: the 3D scan, the digital treatment plan and, in many cases, a surgical guide that places the implant in the exact planned position.

When two quotes look very different, the difference is often in what is included. Ask whether the price covers the crown and the abutment, or only the implant post.

What changes the price

How many teeth are missing. One implant for one tooth is the simplest case. Several missing teeth can sometimes be replaced with fewer implants carrying a bridge, which can cost less than one implant per tooth.

The bone. An implant needs enough healthy bone to hold it. If a tooth has been missing for a long time, the bone may have shrunk, and a bone graft or sinus lift may be needed first. This adds a step and time to the treatment.

The position of the tooth. Front teeth need the most careful work on the look of the gum and crown. Back teeth take the most chewing force.

The crown material. Zirconia and full ceramic crowns look the most natural; the choice affects the final price.

Immediate or staged treatment. In some cases the implant can be placed on the same day the tooth is removed. In others the area needs to heal first.

Why digital planning matters

At Bright Way Dental Clinic, implants are planned digitally: a 3D scan shows the bone in detail, and the implant position is planned on screen before treatment starts. This means fewer surprises, a more accurate result and, often, a more comfortable procedure. Dr. Hasan A. Mahdy is licensed by the Dubai Health Authority (DHA) as a Dental Implant Specialist.

Does insurance cover implants?

Some insurance plans in Dubai cover part of implant treatment, many do not. Bring your insurance details to the consultation and we will check what your plan covers. Read more in our guide to dental insurance in Dubai.

Bright Way is currently offering 10% off dental implants. Ask about it when you book.

The best next step

title: Veneers and Hollywood Smile in Dubai: Types, Results and What Affects the Price
excerpt: "Hollywood smile" is one of the most searched dental terms in Dubai. It usually means a full, bright, even smile made with veneers on the teeth that show when you smile. Before you book, it helps to know the options, because they look different, last differently and cost differently.

seo.description: Porcelain or composite veneers, how many you need for a Hollywood smile, and what changes the price in Dubai. Plan your smile digitally at Bright Way Dental Clinic.

html:
"Hollywood smile" is one of the most searched dental terms in Dubai. It usually means a full, bright, even smile made with veneers on the teeth that show when you smile. Before you book, it helps to know the options, because they look different, last differently and cost differently.

What a veneer is

A veneer is a thin shell bonded to the front of a tooth. It changes the tooth's colour, shape and length. Veneers can close small gaps, cover stains that whitening cannot remove and make uneven teeth look even.

Porcelain or composite?

Porcelain (ceramic) veneers are made in a lab, or with CAD/CAM, from a digital design. They resist stains, keep their shine and last for many years with good care. They usually need a small amount of the tooth surface to be prepared.

Composite veneers are built up directly on the tooth in the chair. They take less time and less preparation, but they can stain and chip more easily and may need polishing or repair over time.

Your dentist will recommend the right one after looking at your teeth, your bite and what you want to change.

How many veneers make a Hollywood smile?

Most people show between 8 and 10 upper teeth when they smile, so a full smile makeover often covers that many. Some patients need fewer, for example only the front 4 or 6 teeth. The number of veneers is the biggest factor in the final price.

What else changes the price

  • The material: porcelain or composite.
  • Preparation work: gum shaping, old fillings or crowns that need replacing, or whitening of the lower teeth to match.
  • The design process: a digital smile design and a trial smile let you see the result before anything is done to your teeth.

See your new smile before you commit

At Bright Way Dental Clinic we use Digital Smile Design: we photograph and scan your smile and design the new teeth on screen. You can see and approve the shape and colour first. Visit our Smile Gallery for real before and after results from the clinic.

title: Does Dental Insurance Cover Treatment in Dubai?
excerpt: Health insurance is compulsory for residents in Dubai, but dental cover is not the same on every plan. Many patients only find out what their policy includes when they are already in the dentist's chair. Here is how to check before your visit.

seo.title: Does Insurance Cover Dental Treatment in Dubai? | Bright Way Dental Clinic
seo.description: What Dubai health insurance usually covers for dental care, what it often leaves out and how to check your plan. Bright Way accepts GlobeMed, Daman, Bupa, Mednet, NGI and Orient.

html:
Health insurance is compulsory for residents in Dubai, but dental cover is not the same on every plan. Many patients only find out what their policy includes when they are already in the dentist's chair. Here is how to check before your visit.

What insurance often covers

Every policy is different, but dental benefits in Dubai commonly fall into these groups:

  • Basic and emergency care: check-ups, X-rays, fillings, extractions and treatment for pain or infection.
  • Some treatments with a limit: root canal treatment, gum treatment or crowns, often with a yearly limit or a share you pay yourself (co-pay).

What it often leaves out

Cosmetic treatments are usually not covered, for example teeth whitening and veneers for appearance. Orthodontics and implants are covered on some enhanced plans and excluded on others.

How to check your cover in three steps

  1. Look for the dental section in your policy table of benefits, or ask your HR team.
  2. Note the yearly dental limit and your co-pay percentage.
  3. Send us your insurance card before your visit. We will confirm with your insurer what is covered, and some treatments need approval from the insurer before they start.

Insurance companies we accept

Bright Way Dental Clinic works with GlobeMed, Daman, Bupa, Mednet, NGI National General Insurance and Orient Insurance. If your provider is not on this list, contact us and we will check for you.

If treatment is not covered

We will explain the cost before any treatment starts, so there are no surprises. For implants, ask about our current 10% offer.

Call +971 55 497 1986 or WhatsApp us with a photo of your insurance card.

title: Emergency Dentist in Dubai: What to Do and When to Call
excerpt: Dental problems rarely happen at a good time. Knowing what to do in the first hour can save a tooth and a lot of pain.

seo.title: Emergency Dentist in Dubai: What to Do First | Bright Way Dental Clinic
seo.description: Toothache, a broken or knocked-out tooth, swelling: what to do first and when to see a dentist in Dubai. Call or WhatsApp Bright Way Dental Clinic in Al Garhoud.

html:
Dental problems rarely happen at a good time. Knowing what to do in the first hour can save a tooth and a lot of pain.

When it is an emergency

See a dentist as soon as possible if you have:

  • Severe toothache that painkillers do not control
  • Swelling in the face, jaw or gum
  • A tooth knocked out or pushed out of place
  • A broken tooth with a sharp edge or pain
  • Bleeding that does not stop after an extraction

Go to a hospital emergency department straight away if the swelling is spreading, you have a high fever, or you have trouble breathing or swallowing.

First aid while you wait

Knocked-out adult tooth: hold it by the crown (the white part), not the root. Rinse it gently if dirty, and put it back in the socket if you can. If not, keep it in milk or in your cheek and see a dentist within an hour.

Broken tooth: rinse with warm water, save any pieces, and use a cold compress on the cheek to reduce swelling.

Toothache: rinse with warm salt water and gently floss to remove any trapped food. Do not put aspirin directly on the gum.

Lost filling or crown: keep the crown safe and bring it with you. Avoid chewing on that side.

Call us first

At Bright Way Dental Clinic in Al Garhoud we keep time for urgent cases during opening hours, Saturday to Thursday, 11 AM to 8 PM. Call +971 55 497 1986 or WhatsApp us, describe what happened, and we will tell you how soon you should come in.

Preventing the next emergency

Most dental emergencies start as small problems. Regular check-ups, a mouthguard for contact sports and treating a sensitive tooth early stop many of them before they start.

title: Teeth Whitening in Dubai: In-Clinic vs Home Kits
excerpt: Coffee, tea and time all darken teeth. Whitening is one of the quickest ways to refresh a smile, but the results, and the risks, depend on how it is done.

seo.title: Teeth Whitening in Dubai: In-Clinic vs Home Kits | Bright Way Dental Clinic
seo.description: Professional teeth whitening in Dubai compared with home kits: results, safety, sensitivity and what affects the price. Book at Bright Way Dental Clinic, Al Garhoud.

html:
Coffee, tea and time all darken teeth. Whitening is one of the quickest ways to refresh a smile, but the results, and the risks, depend on how it is done.

In-clinic whitening

A dentist protects your gums, then applies a professional-strength gel to the teeth. Results are visible after one visit, and the dentist controls the strength so sensitivity is kept low.

Take-home kits from the dentist

Custom trays are made to fit your teeth, and you wear them with a lower-strength gel at home for a set number of days. The result is gradual and easy to top up later.

Shop-bought products

Strips, pens and charcoal pastes are cheap, but they have low strength, fit poorly, and abrasive powders can wear the enamel. Whitening products bought online may also not meet UAE health standards.

Who should not whiten yet

Whitening does not change the colour of veneers, crowns or fillings. If you have tooth decay, gum disease or very sensitive teeth, these should be treated first. A check-up tells you whether whitening is right for you, or whether veneers would give a better result.

What affects the price

The method (in-clinic, take-home or both), whether a cleaning is needed first, and how many sessions your shade needs.

Keep the result longer

Rinse with water after coffee or tea, avoid smoking and keep up regular cleanings.
